description: Chinese platform-team memory: database migration, deployment, a payment-timeout incident, logging and messaging. Evidence is two ADRs, the deployment YAML and payment-service code from the repository, the 2026-09-12 incident postmortem and the 2026-09-28 architecture meeting that postponed the database cutover. Hard parts: settings changed after the incident (the old timeout survives in a comment, and the memory keeps both values), a staging value next to the production one, a value that belongs to another service, a rule stated only for night releases, and negation characters that negate nothing (无异常, 未来, 无论) next to ones that do (非幂等, 暂不强制).
